method.explanation: Recover prior field softmax shares from original p; exclude six publicly listed scratches; apply frozen 0.30 * pace_direction * (historical_settle_fraction - 0.5) in original logit units; renormalise all active entries with original reserve. No field-dependent features are recomputed.
